# V. D. Satheesan

Venad Dasan Satheesan (born 15 May 1967) is an Indian politician serving as the Leader of the Opposition in the Kerala Legislative Assembly since 2021. He is a member of the Indian National Congress and currently serves as the President of the Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC). He is the Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from Peravoor constituency.

## Early life and education

Satheesan was born on 15 May 1967 in Peravoor, Kannur district, Kerala. He completed his schooling at Government Higher Secondary School, Peravoor. He completed his graduation in Science from Brennan College, Thalassery. He was a student leader in the Kerala Students Union (KSU) and was elected as the president of the KSU in 1990. He later completed his law degree from Government Law College, Kozhikode.

## Political career

Satheesan was first elected to the Kerala Legislative Assembly in 2006 from Peravoor constituency. He was re-elected in 2011, 2016, 2021, and 2026. He served as the Minister for Home, Vigilance, and Devaswom in the UDF government from 2011 to 2016. He was elected as the Leader of the Opposition in the Kerala Legislative Assembly in 2021. He was elected as the KPCC president in January 2025.

In May 2026, he was elected as the Chief Minister of Kerala.

## Personal life

Satheesan is married to Sindhu Satheesan. They have two children.
